headline: Executive order gives a federal official power under the Defense Production Act over food supply chain resources during COVID-19.
what_it_does: This order hands off presidential powers under the Defense Production Act, a law that lets the government direct private industry in emergencies. The powers cover resources in the food supply chain. It was issued during the national emergency declared for the COVID-19 outbreak. No official summary was provided, so details beyond the title are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They could be subject to federal direction under the Defense Production Act to keep food supply chain resources available.

who_it_affects.group: Workers in the food supply chain
who_it_affects.how: Their workplaces could be affected by federal orders on how food supply operations continue during the emergency.
